newsitem.title: USA: Miller Building stake cut by Trigran.
newsitem.headline: Miller Building stake cut by Trigran.

text.p: Trigran Investments L.P. said Tuesday it cut its stake in Miller Building Systems Inc to 125,000 common shares, or four percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Trigran said its latest transactions include the sale of 76,100 common shares between December 9 and January 24 at prices ranging from $7.85 to $8.96 per share.
Miller Building, based in Elkhart, Ill., is engaged in manufacturing and distributing factory built buildings for commercial and governmental use.
